The '''Echo Base medical lab''' was the medical facility of [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. It was destroyed with the base in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].

==Features==
[[File:21BTendsLuke.jpg|thumb|left|Medical lab]]
The lab consisted of several rooms and featured at least two medical droids, [[2-1B/Legends|2-1B]] and [[FX-7/Legends|FX-7]], as well as a [[Bacta tank/Legends|bacta tank]].<ref name="SWE5" />

The [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Tenk Lenso]] was transferred from an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Hospital ship/Legends|medical frigate]] to the medical lab's bacta tank after the complete destruction of his former [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]], the [[Deretta Destroyers]].<ref name="GG3">''[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back]]''</ref>

[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] was placed there after being attacked by a [[Wampa/Legends|wampa]] as well as spending hours in a cold blizzard.<ref name="SWE5" />

During the late stages of the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], after a cave-in forced Leia Organa and Han Solo to use the ''Millennium Falcon'' to escape the imminent arrival of Imperial forces, they briefly stopped by the medical lab, and managed to recover medical supplies from the lab, while en-route to the ''Falcon''{{'s}} hangar.<ref name="Rebel Strike">''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron III: Rebel Strike]]''</ref>

The base was destroyed in the attack.<ref name="SWE5" />

{{Loc-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Echo Base medical lab first appeared in [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']].
